notes.title: Version 2.2.0 has been released to Public Beta!
notes.content: [p]Num One: Revised Edition version 2.2.0 has been added to the [b]public-beta[/b] branch if anyone would like to start using it early![/p][p][/p][p]Version 2.2.0 adds the ability to save your selected color themes and block themes into 6 custom slots each, so you can switch between themes without having to recreate your favorite custom theme! [/p]

notes.title: Version 2.2.0 Feature Preview
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812236/700c19a15f5303463a44e02dca4644dafa037627.png"][/img][/p][p]Ever want to try out a different color theme, but don't want to lose the one you're current using? Soon, with update Num One: Revised Edition 2.2.0 update, you'll be able to save up to 6 custom color and 6 custom tile theme slots![/p][p][/p][p]Version 2.2.0 will ship this feature along with internal changes that support theme DLC content.[/p][p][/p][p]The UI depicted may not be final.[/p]

notes.title: Version 2.1.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[2.1.7] Patch Notes
-Added new block "framed square"
-Minor improvement to graphic and text appearance
-Fixed blocks continuing to populate if exiting to main menu while board is being created
-Fixed blocks getting stuck on screen when restarting the game quickly
-Fixed blocks populating in a rotated state when restarting the board mid-update
-Fixed GameOver pop-up text not updating color in Light mode
-Fixed framerate when vsync is turned off

notes.title: Version 2.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[2.1.6] Patch Notes
-Added swap duration, drop duration, and selection fade settings
-Increased default swap and drop speeds slightly
-Fixed issues with various resolutions in windowed mode
-Fixed hint button to be properly disabled when it should be
-Fixed blocks persisting when resetting in certain cases

notes.title: Shapes Update!
notes.content:
[2.1.5] Patch Notes
-Added 5 new block shapes (Triangle, Pentagon, Hexagon, Heptagon, Circle)
-Improved first-time play accessibility configuration
-Fixed 7-8x8 mode 7th block type not working
-Fixed level 1+ block shape theme not saving
-Fixed color mode option not checked on startup
-Fixed music volume settings not working

notes.title: Version 2.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[2.1.4] Patch Notes
-Fixed issues with ultrawide screens
-Fixed goal block not updating correctly
-Fixed goal block being incorrectly selectable

notes.title: Num One has been Revised!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It has been an awesome release week for Num One: Revised Edition and we're so happy to see all the reviews, hours played, streams, and feedback! Thank you so much!

We're already working on fixes and the first update should drop soon. In particular, we have a fix incoming for the UI issues with ultrawide resolutions.

Keep the feedback coming and feel free to send any issues you have to our support email. Thank you and have a great week!

-Mik
